recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. The core Specimen source now matches the FHIR-11192 processing terminology intent; any broader editorial cleanup of Specimen processing definitions should be a separate work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-11192 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Specimen. It said `Specimen.treatment` and "Treatment and processing step details" could be confused with clinical treatment, suggested `processingDetails`, and was finally resolved as "change .treatment to .processing".
initial_application: Historical commit 29f4601440af8375fc9f1e19f0d38727cd29aec4 renamed the Specimen backbone and related example/spreadsheet rows from `Specimen.treatment` to `Specimen.processing`. That application left the child procedure short as "Indicates the treatment step  applied to the specimen", which survived in the current `Specimen.processing.method` source.
additional_context: `source/fhir.ini` actively lists `specimen=Specimen`, putting `source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml` in current build scope. Current source had no remaining `Specimen.treatment` path under `source/specimen`; later Specimen processing history concerned separate model details such as time duration and bindings. Targeted Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Changed `source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml` so the `Specimen.processing.method` short description reads "Indicates the processing step applied to the specimen".
source_changes: source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml: updated the `Specimen.processing.method` short description from "treatment step" to "processing step".

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification Specimen issue resolving the confusing `Specimen.treatment` name by changing `.treatment` to `.processing`.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes final WG intent to avoid clinical-treatment wording for the renamed Specimen processing backbone.

evidence_items.summary: The current active StructureDefinition used `Specimen.processing` but retained a `Specimen.processing.method` short description saying `treatment step` before this reconciliation.
evidence_items.learned: The main rename was present, but the residual short description still contradicted the terminology intent of FHIR-11192.
Specimen StructureDefinition source is part of the current FHIR build scope.

evidence_items.summary: Historical Jira-tagged commit renamed Specimen treatment paths and examples to processing but left the child procedure short with `treatment step` wording.
evidence_items.learned: The current residual wording traces to incomplete original application rather than a later work-group reversal.
